name: German European School Singapore
summary: German and European / IB pathways for German-speaking and international families — Dairy Farm / west-central gravity.
body: GESS serves German-curriculum and European/IB tracks, making it a default shortlist for German and Swiss-German households — and others seeking European schooling. Confirm language of instruction by section when you apply; German-section demand tracks corporate relocation cycles. Campus geography sits in the west-central / Dairy Farm belt — pair housing decisions with school-bus catchments rather than CBD prestige postcodes. Verify current campus map, section availability, and fee stack on gess.sg. German-curriculum continuity is the product; still verify sibling discount lines and capital levies in writing when a second child joins mid-posting. Confirm bazaar shift lengths and parent-portal lead times — dual-career families need calendar-ready notices, not day-of WhatsApp surprises.
waitlistNotes: German-section demand tracks corporate relocation cycles — ask for dated section openings.
